hard_rules.rule: raw evidence cannot be consumed by feature_engineering directly; it must pass source_to_canonical_mapping first.
feature_artifact cannot contain structure judgment labels such as smart_money, suspected_dev,庄家, or PAPER_READY.
structure_signal cannot become strategy behavior without strategy_contract.
replay/backtest/paper-only cannot run without valid strategy_contract and decision_ticket.
PATCH_REQUIRED or BLOCKED runs cannot be promoted to canonical/current.
control_plane runs cannot produce GMGN response, feature_artifact, structure_signal, decision_ticket, validation_report, or paper position artifacts.
downstream modules cannot glob runs/* as truth; they must use manifest/index/gate-approved pointers.
live/swap/private_key/signing/broadcast artifacts are forbidden in every path.
